text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: This world ain't right.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: How come nobody's payin' me anyattention? Don't they all know howawesome I am?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahaha!<n>MWAHAHAHAHAHA!

text_block_list.name: Lackeys
text_block_list.text:
Ooohh! It's Wicked Windy! Outta the<n>way! The boss
is comin' through!<n>Man, check out her awesome
aura...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Cool it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Gimme the rundown on the lowlands.

text_block_list.name: Lackey A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Great One! Everyone can't stop<n>talking about
how Shinko Windy's<n>'bout to be running in the
Twinkle<n>Series!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mwehehe... I'm a big name already...<n>Yes! Just as
planned.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll conquer each and every one of<n>those shiny
racecourses...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And bring the world to its knees! I'll<n>strike fear into
the hearts of everyone<n>as they grovel beneath my
feet!

text_block_list.name: Lackeys
text_block_list.text: YEEEAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll sink my fangs so deep into the<n>tracks, racing's
never gonna be the<n>same!

text_block_list.name: Lackeys
text_block_list.text: YEEEAAAHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
MWAHAHA! Yesss, look at me! I<n>need more...
MORE gazes my way!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The whole world's eyes will soon be<n>fixed on the
big bad herself—Wicked<n>Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nngh?! ...I was dreaming?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
O-oh, yeah! Training with<n>what's-their-face starts
today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At last, my journey with Shinko<n>Windy to compete
in the Twinkle<n>Series has begun. Except...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: GRAWR!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Bwahaha! Gotcha good! Mornin',<n>Lackey!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Leaping in from a nearby roof is<n>Shinko Windy. I'm
glad to see she<n>can face the morning brimming with
energy, but...
choice_data_list:
You're gonna injure your legs jumping from up
high like that.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mugh! Guess you've got a point.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Fine... I'll control the urge next time!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gotta make sure these legs are in top<n>condition so
they can tear the track to<n>shreds! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She'll listen to what I say as long as<n>it's for racing.
She's a bit of a<n>prankster, but deep down, she's
serious about the Twinkle Series.
choice_data_list: All right, then. Let's get straight to training!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAAWR!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy plants her foot in the<n>dirt still wet
from last night's rain and<n>kicks off with all her
might. She flies<n>down the track, paying no mind to
the<n>splattering mud in her wake!
choice_data_list: (Her power never ceases to impress me!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It's only morning, but you're<n>all muddy,
Windy! Running in dirt must<n>be hard...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heehee! Aren't I cool?! Bein'<n>covered in mud is
the badge of a<n>baddie!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
R-right... But wouldn't you rather run<n>on turf? After
all, that's where all the<n>eyes are at.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm curious about that as<n>well. For
someone who craves<n>attention, it's strange that
she<n>wouldn't choose turf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Turf races draw not only most of the<n>fans, but most
of the competitors as<n>well. Dirt, on the other hand...
has a<n>reputation for doing the opposite.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... Something's just kinda off<n>about turf. It's
too green and serene.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Lemme give it to you straight. Heroes<n>duke it out on
turf, but dirt's where<n>supervillains prove who's
boss!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Get it now?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
'Sides, doing the same thing as<n>everybody else
just 'cause it's<n>popular or whatever is boring.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants to stand out in her own<n>way... Fitting for
a girl with her<n>mischievous disposition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And at the end of the day, her true<n>weapon is her
power, which makes<n>her a better fit for dirt over turf
anyway.
choice_data_list:
(Whatever the reason, she's right to have chosen
dirt.)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I may be a dirt racer, but I'mma grab<n>more
headlines than any of those<n>Goody Two-shoes on
turf!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I wanna do another run!<n>We've got no time
to be just<n>standin' around!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Let's give it our all!
Yeah! Let's give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Shinko Windy dives headfirst<n>into training.
However...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nngh... Zzz...

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Windy! Dozing off again? We're in<n>the middle of
class!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Shut up... Lemme have a few<n>Z's! I trained a
whole bunch this<n>morning!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha! Take that!

text_block_list.name: Teacher B
text_block_list.text: Stop that this instant!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! Make me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: URGAAAH?! Hands off! I'mma<n>bite'cha!

text_block_list.name: Teacher B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're her trainer, yes? Would<n>you do
something about her? She's<n>nothing but trouble,
inside and outside<n>of class!
choice_data_list: I-I'd like to hear what she has to say first!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't be right to make a<n>one-sided decision! I
calm Shinko<n>Windy down and ask what happened.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Turns out she was definitely out of<n>line. So we both
apologize and I give<n>her a stern talking-to.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Mnfff.
choice_data_list: Try to keep the mischief to a minimum.
Try to keep the mischief to a minimum.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: HMPH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her behavior has to be coming from<n>her insatiable
competitive spirit and<n>yearning for recognition...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she can channel those emotions<n>into her running,
I have no doubt<n>she'll leave a clear, distinct mark
on<n>the racing world.
choice_data_list:
You'll stand out more on the track than by doing
little pranks.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: No duh! That's 'cause I'm the<n>strongest out there!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The second they see me burst outta<n>that gate,
everyone's eyes will be<n>glued to me!
choice_data_list: Guess we'd better get to training then!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hngh... If you say so. Everyone can<n>consider
themselves lucky that I'm<n>cutting the pranks short
for today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may be a handful, but I believe<n>she'll be a real
force on the<n>racetrack. First things first, I've got to
get her ready to debut.
